name: Grand Canyon Rim to Rim
why: From the forests of the North Rim down Bright Angel Canyon to Phantom Ranch by the Colorado River and up the other side to the South Rim.
book: Backcountry permit for nights below the rim (Cottonwood, Bright Angel campground; apply on the first of the month four months ahead) or a Phantom Ranch lottery cabin. North Kaibab road open mid-May to mid-October; services on the North Rim are limited since the 2025 fire. Shuttle between rims about 4.5 h by road.
water: Seasonal water at Supai Tunnel, Manzanita, Cottonwood, Phantom Ranch and the Bright Angel rest houses; pipeline breaks happen: check before you go.
dangers: Heat in the inner canyon over 40°C from May to September: walk at dawn.
Rangers do not advise rim to rim in one day.
Rockfall on the North Kaibab after storms.
turnaround: Do not leave Phantom Ranch after 10:00 in summer: wait for the evening.
